result:
I’d make it so every person could reliably tell the difference between truth and lies—at least in communication with one another.

Not by “mind reading,” not by removing privacy, but by building a strong default trust layer into conversation: if you’re sharing information, the listener would be able to see whether it’s verifiably true, false, or unknown based on credible evidence. That would massively cut through propaganda, scams, manipulation, and “facts” that are really just vibes—so we could spend our energy on solving real problems instead of arguing about what’s real.
